summary: Kitchen fridge odour and shared space hygiene request
description: Issue summary: Persistent unpleasant odour from the main kitchen fridge on floor 4 near the serving-runtime team. Impact: staff comfort and potential food safety concerns; several employees reported nausea and avoided the kitchen during afternoon. Environment: office kitchen (4th floor), building HQ. Initial observations: small leak and several expired containers found on 2025-06-09 after lunch period. Facilities checked refrigerator temperature cycling and reported occasional spikes outside nominal range. Steps taken so far: removed obvious spoiled items, placed a temporary absorbent under the rear shelf, posted a sign asking people to label perishables. Suggested remediation: schedule vendor deep clean, inspect/repair thermostat and gasket, add labeled-perishables policy reminder, consider replacing unit if thermal instability persists. Related ticket references: FCL-996 (fridge temp logs), facilities follow-up FCL-1002.
comments: Marcus Reyes (assignee) 2025-06-10: Visited kitchen, found spill behind milk containers. Removed spoiled items and cleaned visible spill. Left a note for the team to check labeled items.
Avery Chen (reporter) 2025-06-11: Thanks Marcus — can Facilities schedule a deep clean and confirm fridge thermostat logs for the past 2 weeks?

Facilities Team 2025-06-12: Vendor deep clean scheduled for 2025-06-14. We will inspect gasket and temperature controller; if unit fails diagnostics we will request replacement quote. See FCL-1002 for vendor scheduling.
Marcus Reyes 2025-06-12: Posted temporary fridge etiquette stickers and a bin for expired items. Monitoring for 72h and will update this ticket with any recurrence.
